## Default register

| Choice | Current value | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Threshold-step reference | Moment-nested policy SB / PEBA4 | Open calibration | Development pilot only |

## Question and short answer

Does the DWLS configural-to-threshold-invariant test retain nominal size when
the larger model is correct or misspecified? Production evidence is pending.
The frozen pilot completed 20 draws in each of eight cells (160 fit pairs),
all converged and returned the three policy reference arms. Its full-grid
extrapolation is 36.2 CPU-hours. The delta WLSMV comparator returned typed
`not_nested` throughout. These development draws cannot establish calibration
or justify changing the policy.

## Pilot evidence

```{r}
base <- "results/pilot"
if (!file.exists(file.path(base, "summary.csv")))
  stop("Run run_experiment.R --pilot --cell 17,18,65,66,209,210,257,258 --workers 2 --out-dir results/pilot")
s <- read.csv(file.path(base, "summary.csv"))
cost <- read.csv(file.path(base, "cost.csv"))
tab <- cost[c("observed_cells", "full_cells", "production_cpu_hours", "unpriced_cells")]
names(tab) <- c("Pilot Cells", "Full Grid Cells", "Estimated CPU Hours", "Unpriced Cells")
knitr::kable(tab, digits=2)
```

Full cell rates, Wilson intervals, availability and failures are in the frozen
CSV files. Pilot flags are development diagnostics. The cost extrapolation uses
factor/parameterization family means and excludes cloud startup/build time.

## Caveats

Six policy cell/arm rates fall outside the registered band in this tiny pilot;
these are diagnostic flags, not confirming evidence. Twenty draws have
substantial sampling uncertainty. The bounded pilot covers matched null/power cells for both factor counts and
parameterizations at N = 500 with four symmetric categories and correct models.
It does not cover other categories, sample sizes or misspecification. The full
20-draw grid would exceed the ten-minute pilot budget based on smoke timing. Identical
group distributions preserve the pseudo-null; the one-factor misspecification
uses a residual correlation because a cross-loading requires two factors.
The requested phase seed bases overlap across the 384-cell grid; registration
must amend them to disjoint ranges before held-out production.
The criteria remain a draft for merger review. No production or Modal job has
been launched.

## Reproduce

From this directory, using a lane R library and one BLAS/OpenMP thread:

```sh
Rscript run_experiment.R --help
Rscript run_experiment.R --smoke --workers 2 --out-dir results/smoke
Rscript run_experiment.R --pilot --cell 17,18,65,66,209,210,257,258 --workers 2 --out-dir results/pilot
```

Production requires the merger to commit `criteria/threshold_invariance.md`.
Modal fans out stable cell IDs; `modal/combine.R` applies the same summary
function to the cell outputs and validates seeds, provenance and completeness.
